data.one_liner: Prompts users to upgrade the app when a newer version is available in the store
data.what_it_does: The package provides two widgets, UpgradeAlert and UpgradeCard, that detect a newer app version and show a dialog or card. It opens the app store page for the user to update.
use_when: You need a quick, cross‑platform upgrade prompt
You want a simple, customizable dialog or card
You prefer a declarative widget over native in‑app update APIs
avoid_when: You rely on the native In‑App Updates API or Huawei AppGallery API
You need to support platforms that are not listed (e.g., Fuchsia, Linux, macOS, Windows, Web)
You want to avoid scraping public store pages
strengths: Easy to integrate with a single widget
Fully customizable via parameters and themes
weaknesses: Relies on scraping public store pages, not native APIs
Does not support Fuchsia, Linux, macOS, Windows, Web for automatic detection
Limited to app store version checks
data.minimal_example:
```dart
UpgradeAlert(
  child: Scaffold(
    appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('App')),
    body: const Center(child: Text('Checking for updates...')),
  ),
)
```
